method.nameComparison: Exact Unicode name first; separate NFC+casefold+collapsed-whitespace display normalization only; accents not stripped. No identity is assigned from overlap alone.
method.serviceToBaselineAreaRatio: service feature area / baseline feature area
method.substantialOverlapsSelection: All baseline matches with >=0.01 of either feature covered. Best overall and best different-name match retained even if no overlap.
method.sourceModification: No buffering, repair, clipping, snapping, dissolve or source-coordinate edits. Metric transformed geometries used only for measurement.
method.bestMatchZeroOverlapRule: bestOverallMatch or bestDifferentNameMatch is null when every eligible baseline has zero overlap; no arbitrary zero-overlap tie is presented as a match.

interpretation: The baseline is an unreviewed OSM-derived source, not ground truth. Strong overlap supports duplicate or alternate-source identity review. Weak same-name overlap indicates a boundary disagreement, source granularity difference or identity ambiguity; it must not silently create a new quarter. New exact names are candidates pending independent quarter identity evidence and source semantics/rights review.
